MindMap AI by xDev

FeaturesPrivacyPricingPlatformsHelp and legal

Features

Everything a map needs, nothing in the way.

Spend your time thinking, not formatting diagrams. The map stays useful with or without AI.

01

Infinite canvas and outline

Lay topics out on a canvas that grows with your ideas, or switch to the outline to write and reorder quickly. Pan, zoom, collapse branches and undo any step.

02

On-device AI

Apple Intelligence runs on your device to expand a topic, brainstorm, rewrite and summarize. Every suggestion is labelled, and you can edit it before you accept it.

03

Ask About This Map

Ask a question about the map you have open and get an answer from the on-device model, without leaving your work.

04

Tags, tasks, links and more

Add tags, tasks, links, images and floating topics, and connect ideas across branches, so a map stays useful as it grows.

05

Import and export

Bring in Markdown and plain text. Export to Markdown, PNG or PDF, or save a full MindMap AI backup.

06

iCloud sync

Your maps sync through your own private iCloud account to your other devices. xDev cannot read them, and you can turn sync off at any time.

07

Share Extension and Shortcuts

Send text, links, images and PDFs to MindMap AI from other apps. Use Shortcuts, Siri and Spotlight to start a map, add an idea or open a recent map.

08

Connect AI apps on your Mac

Let AI apps such as Claude Code or ChatGPT read your maps through MCP. It stays off until you turn it on, and each app needs its own token.

Privacy

Data Not Collected

MindMap AI has no account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. xDev runs no servers for it, and your maps are never sent to xDev.

Read the privacy policy→
  • AI runs on your device with Apple Intelligence.
  • Maps live on your device and, with iCloud sync, in your own private iCloud account.
  • AI apps you connect on a Mac can read your maps only after you turn it on.

Pricing

Free, with a one-time Pro upgrade.

Core mind mapping is never locked and there are no ads. No subscription.

Platforms

Made for the Mac first.

Mac

Coming soon to the Mac App Store

Built for the Mac first, with every command in the menu bar and keyboard shortcuts. Requires macOS 26 or later. AI features need a Mac with Apple silicon and Apple Intelligence.

iPhone and iPad

Coming later

Touch and Apple Pencil on iPad, quick capture and review on iPhone. One Pro purchase covers all three.
